title: Halloween After-Hours in Miami
igCaption:
Halloween in Miami keeps going after midnight.
Oct. 31, Club Space, Floyd, Edge Miami and Factory Town

Sources: Resident Advisor, Time Out Worldwide, Miami New Times, EDMTunes, RESIDENT Magazine

#Miami #MiamiEvents #HalloweenMiami #ClubSpace

scenes.text: Halloween weekend in Miami has late-night options across downtown and the west side.
Start with Club Space. Resident Advisor lists Halloweek with CamelPhat and Volkoder at Club Space Miami. Time Out includes Space on its Miami club list for nonstop partying.
scenes.caption: Start with Club Space. Resident Advisor lists Halloweek with CamelPhat and Volkoder at Club Space Miami. Time Out includes Space on its Miami club list for nonstop partying.

scenes.text: The Ground at Club Space has its own listings too. Resident Advisor also shows events there, so one address can carry more than one room and more than one lineup.

scenes.text: Floyd adds another Halloween-week stop. Resident Advisor lists OTHERWORLD 5 Year Anniversary at Floyd, Miami. If you hit Floyd for OTHERWORLD, check NEAR for who was there too.

scenes.text: Edge Miami gives Edgewater a late-night option. RESIDENT says it keeps the neighborhood dancing past midnight with no velvet ropes and a tech house calendar. Resident Advisor lists Daft Disko Halloween there.
